newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish fighter plane crashes, two crew dead.
newsitem.headline: Turkish fighter plane crashes, two crew dead.

text.p: A Turkish air force F-4 Phantom jet fighter has crashed, killing the two crew members, on a training flight in central Turkey, state-run Anatolian news agency reported on Wednesday.
Communications with the plane were cut on Tuesday evening, around 10 minutes after it took off from a base in the central province of Konya.
Anatolian quoted the local governor as saying the crash was thought to be the result of a technical fault. Investigations were continuing.
The plane's wreckage was found overnight in countryside.
